mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper frames the antimicrobial library as membrane-active cationic peptides where hydrophobicity and charge influence bacterial membrane interaction and mammalian-cell selectivity.

mechanism_claims.limitations: The source supports assay-level activity relationships; it does not establish a single direct molecular killing mechanism.
